description: Copy and adapt the existing Ralph Wiggum shell loop into jido_run. Use the zclaude wrapper so Claude Code runs through the Z.AI/ZLM configuration. Select one ready Beadwork child task per fresh invocation, require exact acceptance evidence, verify task state and Git state, retry bounded failures, and support dry-run and one-task modes. Complete when the project script passes shell syntax checks and a dry-run lists ready Beadwork tasks without changing task state.

comments.text: Implemented scripts/ralph_wiggum_loop.sh. Evidence: bash -n passed; dry-run listed ready child tasks; one-task dry-run preserved jido-e05-t10 as open; blocked-task and non-GLM model checks failed as intended; default MIX_ENV=test compile plus format gate passed; git diff --check passed. The repository baseline has 14 test failures and mix precommit fails on existing warnings, so the loop supports stronger task-specific gates through --verify-cmd.

title: Add a Zclaude Ralph loop for Beadwork tasks
